newsitem.title: USA: Promise Keepers plan mass Washington rally.
newsitem.headline: Promise Keepers plan mass Washington rally.

text.p: Promise Keepers, an evangelical Christian men's organisation, said Tuesday it plans a mass rally on Washington's Mall Oct. 4 that it hopes will eclipse the Million Man March in 1995.

Founder Bill McCartney, who coached the University of Colorado's football team to a national championship in 1990, told a press conference he wants to invite those black men who attended the Million Man March organised by the Nation of Islam leader Louis Farrakhan to join his rally.
"Only humbled men before God can cross racial barriers," McCartney said in announcing the rally entitled "Stand in the Gap: A Sacred Assembly of Men."
Organisers hope that at least 1 million men will attend, kneel down and pledge renewed faith and loyalty to God, their families and the country during six hours of ceremonies.

Promise Keepers, which was started six years ago, has attracted more than 1 million men to events it has staged at sports stadiums around the country this year, charging men $60 for a programme of Bible study, prayer, rock music and preaching.
